pageDescription: Batch operations: tasks are staggered and queued one per account for workers to execute. Track or cancel progress in Batch Progress, or switch features from the Outreach Center submenu.

materialPick.tooltip: When selected, sends the media with text as its caption; leave blank to send text only.

materials.nameRequired: Enter a name for the material first
materials.textPlaceholder: Message copy (reusable across Bulk PM / Broadcast / Group Storm)
materials.uploadTitle: Upload Media Material (Photo / Video / File, max 20MB)
materials.uploadText: Click or drag a file here to upload
materials.uploadHint: The filename becomes the material name; add a caption when sending

batches.liveHint: Running Group Storm / Persona Chat tasks update progress after each round

joinAndSend.delayAfterJoinTooltip: Fixed wait before posting; 0 uses the send interval below
joinAndSend.verifyTimeoutTooltip: Max wait time for join-verification messages (Cap / NuoMi Turnstile)
joinAndSend.ignoreActiveHoursTooltip: Bypass the active hours window (default 08:00–24:00); circuit breakers and min intervals still apply
joinAndSend.accountsSectionNote: Auto mode picks by health score; rotate mode shares group links across accounts and waves run sequentially
joinAndSend.accountPickTooltip: Auto: picks available accounts by highest health score without manual selection
joinAndSend.dispatchTooltip: Rotate: each group is posted once, links are shared across accounts; Replicate: every account posts to every group
joinAndSend.accountsPerWaveTooltip: e.g., 100 accounts per wave; 0 runs all accounts in a single wave
joinAndSend.groupsPerAccountTooltip: e.g., 10 groups per account per wave; 0 assigns all groups in one pass
joinAndSend.maxAccountsTooltip: 0 = unlimited; selects top N accounts by health score
joinAndSend.submitDesc: Rotate mode shares group links across accounts; each account joins, verifies, and posts per group; runs wave by wave, stop anytime

rhythmPresets.label: Pacing Presets:
rhythmPresets.safeDetail: For new or recently unbanned accounts: long intervals, daytime only, low daily cap
rhythmPresets.normalDetail: Everyday default: moderate intervals, daytime window, 50/day per account
rhythmPresets.fastDetail: For aged accounts needing volume: short intervals, full daytime, 120/day (use at own risk)
rhythmPresets.unlimitedDetail: For pre-budgeted pools: clears window and quota caps, relying on throttling alone

actionTab.scheduledSuccess: Added to schedule queue. View or pause it in Active Schedules below.
actionTab.scheduleSectionNote: When enabled, runs a new batch every N minutes instead of once immediately; see next run times below
actionTab.scheduleWindowTooltip: Leave blank for no limit; e.g. 09:00-22:00 defers out-of-window runs until window start
actionTab.scopeSectionNote: Frozen / invalid / disabled accounts are skipped automatically (they cannot send); check / appeal / warm-up ignore this filter
actionTab.submitDesc: Staggered one task per account for workers; view progress or cancel in Batch Progress

schedulePanel.runNowSuccess: Triggered one run; check Batch Progress for status
schedulePanel.title: Active Schedules
schedulePanel.note: Automatically submits a batch on schedule using the configured targets, copy, and scope; pausing does not affect already-queued tasks
schedulePanel.empty: No schedules yet: configure the form above, toggle Add to Schedule Queue, and submit

bulkPm.title: Bulk PM
bulkPm.description: Each account sends messages to targets sequentially. Providing multiple lines in the text pool assigns distinct lines across accounts. Targets accept @username, phone number, or numeric user ID (one per line or comma-separated).
bulkPm.targetsRequired: At least one target is required
bulkPm.textPlaceholder: Overrides the text pool when filled
bulkPm.textsLabel: Text Pool (assigned modulo account, one per line)
bulkPm.parseModeTooltip: Markdown: **bold**, > quote, `code`; HTML: bold. Leave blank for plain text
bulkPm.forwardTooltip: Provide source chat ID and message ID to forward an existing message instead of sending text; enable Hide Source to drop attribution
bulkPm.sendWindowTooltip: Sends only within this window; out-of-window tasks defer until start. Leave blank for no limit
bulkPm.dailyQuotaTooltip: Max messages per account per day; overflow defers to the next day. 0 = unlimited
bulkPm.naturalizeTooltip: Applies subtle phrasing and punctuation variations so messages are not identical
bulkPm.viaBotTooltip: Sending via Bot skips account daily quotas and freeze risks, but Telegram only allows bots to PM users who have already interacted with them
bulkPm.dispatchTooltip: Round-robin splits targets across accounts so each target is contacted by only one account
bulkPm.autoSupplyTooltip: Automatically pulls healthy accounts from the pool when available accounts are insufficient; replenished accounts still follow quotas and throttling

broadcast.title: Group Broadcast
broadcast.description: Each account posts one message to the specified groups. Targets support @username, numeric group ID, or synced dialog ID.
broadcast.textsLabel: Text Pool (assigned modulo account, one per line)
broadcast.targetGroupsTooltip: Populated from synced dialogs; the count in parentheses shows how many accounts can post in that group
broadcast.onlyMembersTooltip: Automatically skips accounts not in the target group to avoid wasted queue slots and unnecessary rate limits
broadcast.ignoreActiveHoursTooltip: Bypass active hours (default 08:00–24:00) and send overnight too; min intervals, daily quotas, and circuit breakers still apply

materialSend.title: Material Broadcast
materialSend.description: Send text or media from the Material Library: enter a target group to broadcast, or PM targets to send individually.
materialSend.materialRequired: Create a material in the library first
materialSend.targetsLabel: PM Targets (pick one, one per line)
materialSend.dispatchTooltip: Round-robin splits targets across accounts in parallel without duplicates

join.title: Bulk Join Groups
join.description: Join one or more groups using invite links (t.me/+...) or @public usernames, one per line. Existing memberships are skipped; use Round-Robin to distribute groups across accounts.
join.coverTooltip: Computes missing memberships automatically: skips accounts already in a group and queues one task per account with 20–60s intervals
join.targetsLabel: Invite Links or Public Groups (one per line)
join.dispatchTooltip: Round-robin assigns each group to a single account to avoid flooding the same group at once
join.autoVerifyTooltip: Detects verification bots (Cap / NuoMi Turnstile), completes browser verification, and confirms posting access; leaves and retries on failure
join.verifyTimeoutTooltip: Max wait for the verification bot message. Links expire quickly (NuoMi 60s, Cap 300s), so overly long waits are unnecessary
join.ignoreActiveHoursTooltip: Defaults to local 08:00–24:00 to avoid overnight batch patterns; enable to run immediately while keeping circuit breakers, intervals, and quotas active

leave.title: Bulk Leave Groups
leave.description: Leave one or more groups, one per line. Supports @username, numeric group ID, or dialog ID; use Round-Robin to split groups across accounts.
leave.targetsRequired: At least one group is required
leave.dispatchTooltip: Round-robin assigns each group to a single account

forceAdd.title: Force Add Members
forceAdd.description: Add members into one or more target groups. Executing accounts must be group admins (or have the member as a contact for basic groups). Members: @username, phone, or numeric user ID, one per line (max 50).
forceAdd.groupsRequired: At least one group is required
forceAdd.membersRequired: At least one member is required

profile.title: Bulk Profile Update
profile.description: Update name, bio, username, or avatar across accounts. Single line applies to all accounts; multiple lines form a candidate pool so accounts stay distinct. Blank fields are unchanged. Save sets as templates for reuse.
profile.fixedUsernameTooltip: Enter username directly; @ or t.me links are stripped automatically. 5–32 chars, letters/digits/underscore, starting with a letter
profile.bioPlaceholder:
Bio line 1
Bio line 2
Bio line 3
profile.usernamePrefixTooltip: Usernames are globally unique; prefix + random digits avoids collisions across accounts
profile.assignModeTooltip: Sequential cycles through the pool without repeats; Random picks independently per account
profile.avatarTooltip: Pick an image from the Material Library, or enter a URL below
profile.avatarPlaceholder: Pick an image from Material Library (optional)

storm.title: Group Chat Storm
storm.description: Accounts take turns posting lines from the text pool at random intervals in one group, with optional probability of replying to recent messages. Total duration = rounds × max interval (max 25 min).
storm.textsLabel: Text Pool (random line per round, one per line)
storm.textsRequired: At least one line is required

persona.title: Persona Chat
persona.description: Accounts converse continuously in character: each round reads recent group messages and generates a reply via AI, falling back to the backup text pool if AI is unavailable.
persona.personaPlaceholder: e.g., You are a 25-year-old tech enthusiast who writes short, casual messages.
persona.topicPlaceholder: Leave blank to follow the current group conversation
persona.fallbackTextsLabel: Fallback Text Pool When AI Is Unavailable (one per line)
